name: YS LeadGen – Popup Builder, Lead Generation Forms & Marketing Campaigns
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Every website has a goal.

Whether it’s growing an email list, generating enquiries, promoting products, increasing sales, or engaging visitors, successful websites rely on the right message at the right time.

Create beautiful popups, lead generation forms, newsletter signups, announcement bars, surveys, countdown campaigns, and more using an intuitive drag-and-drop builder that’s designed to help you launch campaigns in minutes.

Everything works together from a single dashboard, making it easy to build, publish, manage, and optimize your marketing campaigns without juggling multiple plugins.

Your campaigns run directly on your website, giving you complete control over your customer data, performance, and user experience.

Why Choose YS LeadGen?

Marketing your website shouldn’t be complicated.

Instead of installing separate plugins for popups, forms, surveys, countdown timers, cookie consent, analytics, and promotional campaigns, manage everything from one place.

Launch campaigns faster, deliver a consistent experience across your website, and optimize every interaction from a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

Whether you’re welcoming first-time visitors, capturing leads, promoting limited-time offers, collecting feedback, or encouraging repeat purchases, every campaign is designed to help you create meaningful customer interactions.

Simple to get started.

Flexible as your business grows.

Built for marketers, businesses, creators, and online stores.

Marketing Campaigns You Can Build

Every business is different, so every campaign should support a specific goal.

Create campaigns for:

  • Growing your email list
  • Capturing qualified leads
  • Collecting enquiries
  • Promoting products and services
  • Announcing special offers
  • Recovering abandoning visitors
  • Reducing cart abandonment
  • Increasing customer engagement
  • Collecting surveys and feedback
  • Measuring visitor satisfaction
  • Building customer trust
  • Encouraging repeat purchases

Choose from a wide variety of campaign types, including:

  • Popup Campaigns
  • Exit Intent Popups
  • Newsletter Signups
  • Lead Generation Forms
  • Contact Forms
  • Multi-Step Forms
  • Coupon Campaigns
  • Countdown Timer Campaigns
  • Announcement Bars
  • Floating Bars
  • Slide-In Campaigns
  • Fullscreen Campaigns
  • Survey Forms
  • NPS Surveys
  • Video Popups
  • Social Proof Notifications
  • Content Lockers
  • Age Verification Popups
  • Cookie Consent Banners

Every campaign is fully customizable, mobile responsive, and designed to help you turn more visitors into subscribers, leads, and customers.

Built for Every Website

Whether you’re launching your first website or managing a growing online business, YS LeadGen adapts to your marketing needs.

Ideal for:

  • Online Stores
  • Small Businesses
  • Marketing Agencies
  • Digital Agencies
  • Bloggers
  • Content Creators
  • SaaS Businesses
  • Coaches & Consultants
  • Freelancers
  • Online Courses
  • Membership Websites
  • Educational Institutions
  • Healthcare Providers
  • Real Estate Businesses
  • Non-Profit Organizations
  • Local Businesses

No matter what you build, create marketing campaigns that help your website attract attention, generate leads, build stronger customer relationships, and achieve better results.

Create Campaigns Your Visitors Will Love

Creating effective marketing campaigns shouldn’t require design skills, coding knowledge, or multiple plugins.

Whether you’re welcoming first-time visitors, growing your email list, promoting products, collecting enquiries, or encouraging repeat purchases, everything you need is available in one intuitive visual builder.

Choose a professionally designed template or start from scratch, customize every element to match your website, decide when and where your campaign appears, and publish it in just a few clicks.

Design Beautiful Popups with a Visual Builder

Create engaging popup campaigns using an intuitive drag-and-drop builder that gives you complete creative control without writing code.

Customize layouts, typography, colors, buttons, images, spacing, animations, backgrounds, and more to create campaigns that perfectly match your brand.

Everything is designed to work seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Customize your campaigns with:

  • Drag & Drop Visual Builder
  • Live Preview
  • Ready-to-Use Templates
  • Unlimited Popup Campaigns
  • Responsive Layouts
  • Custom Colors & Typography
  • Background Images & Videos
  • Animation Effects
  • Custom CSS & JavaScript
  • Reusable Templates

Build Forms That Convert Visitors into Leads

Create forms that help you collect enquiries, newsletter subscribers, registrations, bookings, customer feedback, and other valuable information from your visitors.

Whether you need a simple contact form or a multi-step lead generation form, everything works together with your popup campaigns to create a seamless experience.

Create forms including:

  • Lead Generation Forms
  • Contact Forms
  • Newsletter Signup Forms
  • Multi-Step Forms
  • Registration Forms
  • Survey Forms
  • NPS Forms
  • File Upload Fields
  • Custom Fields

Every form also includes:

  • AJAX Form Submission
  • Required Field Validation
  • Spam Protection
  • Privacy Consent Checkbox
  • Success Messages
  • Redirect After Submission

Start Faster with Ready-to-Use Templates

Launching a campaign shouldn’t start with a blank page.

Choose from professionally designed templates created for common marketing goals, customize the content to match your brand, and publish your campaign within minutes.

Templates are available for:

  • Newsletter Signups
  • Lead Generation
  • Product Promotions
  • Discount Offers
  • Exit Intent Campaigns
  • Announcement Bars
  • Countdown Campaigns
  • Seasonal Promotions
  • Surveys
  • Contact Forms
  • Welcome Campaigns

Create Better Campaigns with AI Assistance

Writing headlines and calls to action can take time.

Built-in AI tools help you generate campaign ideas, engaging headlines, persuasive call-to-action buttons, and marketing copy, making it easier to launch campaigns faster while keeping complete control over the final content.

AI can help you generate:

  • Headlines
  • Call-to-Action Buttons
  • Campaign Ideas
  • Marketing Copy
  • Template Recommendations
  • Industry-Specific Suggestions

Whether you’re creating your first campaign or optimizing an existing one, AI helps you work faster and overcome creative blocks.

Deliver Personalized Marketing Experiences

Creating beautiful campaigns is only the beginning.

The real impact comes from showing the right message to the right visitor at the right time. Personalize every interaction based on visitor behavior, page content, and campaign goals to create experiences that feel relevant and encourage action.

Whether you’re growing your email list, generating leads, promoting products, or increasing customer engagement, every campaign can be tailored to your audience.

Grow Your Online Store

Turn more visitors into customers with personalized campaigns designed for online stores.

Promote new arrivals, recommend relevant products, announce free shipping, highlight limited-time offers, and encourage larger purchases throughout the customer journey.

Create campaigns for:

  • Product Promotions
  • Discount & Coupon Offers
  • Free Shipping Announcements
  • Product Recommendations
  • Upsell Campaigns
  • Cross-Sell Campaigns
  • Flash Sales
  • Limited-Time Offers
  • Seasonal Promotions
  • New Product Launches

Whether you’re introducing new products or encouraging repeat purchases, every campaign helps create a better shopping experience.

Reach the Right Visitors at the Right Time

Every visitor is different.

Display campaigns based on visitor behavior, browsing activity, and website conditions so each message appears when it’s most relevant.

Launch campaigns using triggers such as:

  • Exit Intent
  • Time on Page
  • Scroll Percentage
  • User Inactivity
  • Click Events
  • Page Load
  • After Form Submission
  • After Purchase
  • Manual Trigger

Control where campaigns appear using flexible targeting options.

Target visitors based on:

  • Homepage
  • Pages & Posts
  • Landing Pages
  • Categories
  • Product Pages
  • Cart & Checkout
  • New & Returning Visitors
  • Logged-in Users
  • User Roles
  • Devices
  • Browsers
  • Operating Systems
  • Cookie-Based Rules
  • Campaign Scheduling
  • Frequency Controls

Measure What Works

Understand how every campaign performs using built-in analytics and reporting.

Track engagement, monitor conversions, identify your highest-performing campaigns, and use real insights to continuously improve your marketing results.

Track important metrics including:

  • Popup Views
  • Form Submissions
  • Conversions
  • Conversion Rate
  • Campaign Performance
  • Revenue Analytics
  • Subscriber Growth
  • Lead Reports
  • Export Reports

Make informed decisions with data that helps you improve every campaign.

Works with Your Favorite Marketing Tools

Connect your campaigns with the marketing platforms you already use.

Automatically sync new subscribers and leads with your preferred email marketing service to streamline your workflow and keep your audience engaged.

Supported integrations include:

  • Mailchimp
  • HubSpot
  • Brevo
  • Klaviyo
  • Omnisend
  • ActiveCampaign
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • MailerLite
  • Kit (ConvertKit)
  • Webhooks
  • CSV Export

We’re continuously expanding our integrations to support more marketing platforms and automation tools.

Built for Modern WordPress Websites

Creating marketing campaigns should be simple, reliable, and scalable.

Whether you’re managing a personal blog, a business website, an online store, or multiple client websites, everything is designed to help you build, manage, and optimize campaigns without adding unnecessary complexity to your workflow.

As your website grows, your campaigns, forms, and marketing strategies can grow alongside it.

Fast by Design

Marketing campaigns should improve your website, not slow it down.

The plugin is designed to work efficiently with WordPress by loading only the resources needed for your campaigns. Every popup and form is optimized to deliver a smooth experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Built with performance in mind:

  • Lightweight Frontend Assets
  • Optimized CSS & JavaScript
  • Responsive Layouts
  • Lazy Loading Support
  • SEO-Friendly Output
  • Fast Campaign Rendering
  • Clean WordPress Coding Standards
  • Regular Performance Improvements

Keep Your Data on Your Website

Your campaigns, visitor information, and marketing data remain under your control.

Instead of relying on hosted services, everything runs directly on your WordPress website, giving you complete ownership of your data and greater flexibility over how your campaigns are managed.

Privacy tools include:

  • Cookie Consent Banner
  • Privacy Policy Acceptance
  • Consent Checkboxes
  • Spam Protection
  • Secure Form Validation
  • Cookie-Based Display Rules

Always review your local privacy regulations to ensure your website complies with applicable laws.

Built to Work Alongside Your Favorite Tools

Marketing works best when everything is connected.

Sync new subscribers and leads with your preferred email marketing platform, automate follow-up campaigns, and keep your existing workflow running smoothly without unnecessary manual work.

Supported integrations include:

  • Mailchimp
  • HubSpot
  • Brevo
  • Klaviyo
  • Omnisend
  • ActiveCampaign
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • MailerLite
  • Kit (ConvertKit)
  • Webhooks
  • CSV Export

New integrations are added regularly to support modern marketing workflows.

Ready to Grow

Whether your goal is capturing more leads, growing your email list, promoting products, collecting customer feedback, or increasing online sales, the plugin provides the tools to help you create campaigns that support your business as it grows.

Start with a single campaign or build a complete marketing strategy—all from one intuitive dashboard.

Getting Started

Getting started is simple.

  1. Install the plugin.
  2. Create your first campaign.
  3. Choose a professionally designed template or start from scratch.
  4. Customize your campaign using the visual builder.
  5. Connect your preferred email marketing platform.
  6. Configure your display rules and targeting options.
  7. Publish your campaign and start engaging visitors.

Whether you’re creating your first popup or building a complete lead generation strategy, you’ll be ready to launch your first campaign in just a few minutes.

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs entirely on your WordPress website.

The plugin does not collect personal information unless you configure forms or connect third-party services.

Depending on the integrations you enable, visitor information may be processed by third-party email marketing platforms or marketing services that you choose to connect.

You remain in full control of your website data, customer information, and marketing campaigns.

Review your website’s privacy policy and applicable regulations to ensure compliance with local privacy laws.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open YS LeadGen from your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Create your first popup or form.
  5. Configure your campaign settings and display rules.
  6. Publish your campaign.
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen beginner-friendly?

Yes. You can create your first popup or form in just a few minutes using the visual drag-and-drop builder. No coding knowledge is required.

What types of campaigns can I create?

Create popup campaigns, lead generation forms, newsletter signups, contact forms, exit intent campaigns, announcement bars, coupon campaigns, countdown timers, surveys, NPS forms, social proof notifications, content lockers, age verification popups, cookie consent banners, and more.

Can I create unlimited campaigns?

Yes. Create as many campaigns as you need. Some advanced features are available in the Pro version.

Can I customize the design of my campaigns?

Yes. Customize layouts, colors, typography, buttons, images, backgrounds, spacing, animations, and more using the visual builder to match your website.

Does the plugin work on mobile devices?

Yes. Every popup, form, and campaign is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I display campaigns only on specific pages?

Yes. Display campaigns on specific pages, posts, landing pages, products, categories, or based on visitor behavior, devices, user roles, cookies, scheduling rules, and many other targeting conditions.

Can I collect leads without another form plugin?

Yes. Create lead generation forms, newsletter signup forms, contact forms, registration forms, surveys, and multi-step forms without installing an additional form builder.

Does it work with my email marketing platform?

Yes. Connect your campaigns with popular email marketing and automation platforms including Mailchimp, HubSpot, Brevo, Klaviyo, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, MailerLite, Kit (ConvertKit), Webhooks, and CSV Export.

Can I use it to promote products on my online store?

Yes. Create personalized campaigns for product promotions, coupon offers, free shipping announcements, product recommendations, upsells, cross-sells, flash sales, and seasonal promotions.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is built with performance in mind and loads only the resources required for your campaigns to help maintain fast page loading times.

Is my visitor data stored on my website?

Yes. Your campaigns and collected data remain on your own WordPress website, giving you full control over your information and marketing activities.

Does the plugin support AI?

Yes. Built-in AI tools help generate headlines, calls-to-action, campaign ideas, marketing copy, and template recommendations to speed up campaign creation.

Where can I find documentation and support?

Detailed documentation, tutorials, and support resources are available to help you get started, explore features, and troubleshoot any issues you may encounter.

2.2.1

  • Stripe Payment integration inside form.
  • Refactored Woocommerce features.

2.2.0

  • Refactored the Rules section for a cleaner and more flexible campaign targeting workflow.
  • Added SMTP support for form campaigns to improve email deliverability and notification reliability.

2.1.10

  • Added Activity Logs for form campaigns — track submissions, validation, reCAPTCHA, integration syncs, and webhook results in a searchable timeline.
  • Implemented CSV value and row escaping to prevent formula injection when exporting leads.
  • Added MailerLite integration for lead management.
  • Simplified product and category selection logic in WooCommerce display conditions.
  • Added coupon apply mode selection and validation in WooCommerce Coupon popups.

2.1.9

  • Added shareable preview links for campaigns.
  • Added AI Insights (Premium).
  • Added Kit (ConvertKit) integration.
  • Improved onboarding wizard layout and responsiveness.

  • Added Team Collaboration.
  • Added White Label mode.
  • Added ActiveCampaign integration.

  • Added Age Verification campaigns.

  • General stability improvements.
